_comment: Shot list for the Mandate demo. Derived from docs/video/STORYBOARD.md (shots, windows, narration beats) and docs/video/storyboard.json (scene ids and captions; the JSON wins on any disagreement). windowSec is the storyboard's designed length for the shot; the cut uses max(windowSec, narration + padding). kind=title is pure Remotion (no recording); kind=clip plays public/clips/<clip>.mp4; recorder=auto is captured by scripts/capture.mjs, recorder=manual needs a human with a system screen recorder (PayPal's popup rejects automated browsers).
tagline: Spending rules for AI agents. Settled by PayPal.

scenes.caption: Spending rules for AI agents. Settled by PayPal.

shots.narration: AI agents are starting to shop for us.
Giving one a card number is reckless, and approving every click defeats the point.
This is Mandate: spending rules for AI agents, settled by PayPal.

scenes.caption: You set the budget first. The server enforces it.

shots.narration: I start by choosing my own numbers:
a three hundred dollar budget, no single purchase over one hundred and twenty, and only the categories I pick.
Nothing is built in, and until I do this the assistant cannot search or buy.
The server enforces these rules, not a prompt.

scenes.caption: The assistant requests. The server verifies prices. Rules decide.

shots.narration: Now I ask the assistant for a vertical mouse and a desk mat.
It searches the live web, and the server opens each product page itself to read the real price.
Allowed requests wait for me.
Anything outside my rules is blocked before PayPal is ever called, with the exact rule that said no.

scenes.caption: Type the amount. Approve with PayPal. Server captures.

shots.narration: Payments above a set amount ask me to type the amount first.
Then PayPal's own button: I sign in and approve.
shots.note: PayPal's own window: sign in as the test buyer and approve

shots.narration: Only now does the server capture the payment, check the amount, and update my budget.
shots.note: Back in the app: payment captured, toast, budget updates, card shows CAPTURED

shots.narration: Refunds are deliberate.
shots.note: On the captured purchase, click Refund

shots.narration: I acknowledge, start the request,
shots.note: Tick the acknowledgement, press Start refund

shots.narration: and wait through a safety delay before I can confirm.
I can cancel at any time, and nothing moves until I do.
shots.note: Cursor near Cancel, then Confirm refund; the card shows REFUNDED

shots.narration: The assistant can suggest new limits, but only I can apply them.
It can never raise its own budget.
Every decision lands in the ledger and the audit trail,
and finance can export it as a spreadsheet.

scenes.caption: The model proposes. Policy decides. You consent. PayPal settles.

shots.narration: The model proposes, the policy decides, I consent, PayPal settles, and the ledger remembers.
Mandate: spending rules for AI agents.
